---
name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaGame MVP slice for prompt-driven 2D game generation with a playable measurable outcome. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an already-approved mechanic or claiming a complete game generator.
---

# Product scope

- Start from the planned capabilities and Beta criteria in `README.md`.
- Choose one game genre one prompt schema and one reproducible playable output.
- Define success through launchability controls win or loss condition and deterministic validation where possible.
- State unsupported genres assets and export targets.
- Prefer one complete game loop over many incomplete generation features.
- Require a versioned example automated core test and documented limitations.
